description: A white lab rat sits in a small wire cage on a worn wooden lectern. Behind it, a large chalkboard shows a white chalk maze, and a dark jacket hangs over the lectern's left edge. Papers, a pen, an inkwell and a glass of water sit on the desk. The setting is a dim, old-fashioned lecture hall with tiered wooden benches and arched windows. The image is an oil-style painting that fills the frame, with no visible text, frame or wounds.
